assets.title: Homestead jackfruit tree
assets.notes: Medium-sized homestead broadleaf tree with an irregular branching crown, thousands of individually curved elliptic leaves and warted fruits borne on the trunk and large branches. Original approximate Artocarpus heterophyllus form, for well-drained homestead land rather than flooded paddy.

assets.title: Nendran-inspired banana clump
assets.notes: Mother plant and two suckers: overlapping pseudostem sheaths, broad veined and naturally split laminae, rolled spear, hanging unripe hands and purple flower heart. Nendran-inspired, not a cultivar-certified model.

assets.title: Pandanus-style coastal scrub
assets.notes: Three-headed coastal screw-pine form with spiral sword leaves and exposed prop roots. Botanical-form approximation; placement should be selective near coastal or backwater edges.

assets.title: Colocasia-style wet verge foliage
assets.notes: Wet-verge broadleaf clump with modeled heart-shaped peltate blades, strong radial venation and fleshy petioles. Species-inspired approximation for shaded humid verges.

assets.title: Tropical fern understory
assets.notes: Low tropical fern clump with twenty-one individually arched fronds and modeled pinnae. Generic fern form, not a species occurrence claim.

assets.title: Backwater bank with coir protection
assets.notes: 8 x 4 m bank section with removable olive water margin, soil slope, grass, stone scatter and coir fascines tied to timber stakes. Bottom is z=0; water surface z=.343 m; land crest about .74 m.

assets.title: Coir rope coil and coconut husks
assets.notes: Three-layer coiled coir rope with modeled three-strand twist, loose tail and three fibrous coconut husks. Appropriate small dressing for Alappuzha/Kollam backwater working banks.

assets.title: Small traditional country canoe
assets.notes: Open 5.8 m reference-inspired working canoe, with individual plank courses, caulking, ribs, rounded gunwales, three thwarts, a paddle and coir mooring rope. Keel/base is at ground origin; suggested scene waterline z=.20 m. Not a measured boat type replica.

assets.title: Paddy irrigation bund and channel
assets.notes: 8 x 4 m closed earthen module: shallow channel, irregular grassed banks, scattered rubble and a simple timber foot-crossing. Bottom is z=0; water surface z=.148 m; earth bank crest z=.48 m.

assets.title: Green paddy field tile
assets.notes: 4 x 4 m soil footprint with shallow water and 289 irregular rice tufts, each with folded, bowed mesh blades. Vegetation overhangs the soil tile slightly; approximate vegetative stage.

assets.title: Ripening paddy field tile
assets.notes: 4 x 4 m rice tile with green-gold foliage, bent grain-bearing panicles and individual husked grains; illustrative ripening stage rather than a named variety.

assets.title: Green rice tuft for scattering
assets.notes: A single lightweight seven-blade rice tuft for collection/geometry-node scattering, with no soil or water slab. Illustrative vegetative stage.

assets.title: Ripening rice tuft for scattering
assets.notes: A single lightweight rice tuft with bowed panicles and mesh grains, for collection/geometry-node scattering with no soil/water slab. Illustrative ripening stage.

assets.title: Water hyacinth floating patch
assets.notes: Small optional floating patch with rounded glossy leaves, inflated petioles, dangling rootlets and occasional lilac flower spikes. Depicts an invasive plant documented in Kuttanad waterbodies; not a planting recommendation. Place water about .105 m above the base-origin.
